method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole Latin America Memorial frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.7.8125m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Coarse urban composite may contain building/canopy artefacts and does not resolve the building foundation or street thresholds. Exact construction-grade classification is unspecified; source field does not certify ground contact.
